name: Omni View Asia Pacific
tagline: Asia Pacific, one region deep, every day.
description: Omni View Asia Pacific is one of the Nerra Network's regional desks: Asia Pacific, one region deep, every day. The Lead, the stories from across the region, the region's meeting point with the wider world, one contested question with the strongest case on each side, and one measurable sign of progress. Read by Mira, the Nerra Network's AI host — the stories are chosen and written by software from named newsrooms, every item names its source, and every claim is attributed.
